steps.en: Install a signed release, or build and open the app (with the demo project)
steps.zh: 装一个签名发行版，或自己编译后打开应用（可带演示工程）

steps.en: Opens After Effects-style panels: Project, Composition, Timeline, Effect Controls
steps.zh: 打开仿 After Effects 的面板：项目、合成、时间线、效果控件

steps.en: Build a comp: add layers, set keyframes, stack effects, type expressions
steps.zh: 搭一个合成：加图层、打关键帧、叠效果、写表达式

steps.en: Interpolates keyframes and composites each frame, most effects on the GPU
steps.zh: 插值关键帧，逐帧合成，多数效果在 GPU 上算

steps.en: Queue the comp in the Render Queue, or export it as Lottie
steps.zh: 把合成放进渲染队列，或导出为 Lottie

steps.en: Encodes MP4/ProRes/WebM with its own Rust encoders, or writes Lottie and flags what got lost
steps.zh: 用自带的 Rust 编码器出视频，或写出 Lottie 并标出丢失项

component.zh: export 与 FilmCraft 编解码

value.en: After Effects-style motion graphics without a subscription or FFmpeg, saved as diffable JSON
value.zh: 不用订阅、不装 FFmpeg 就能做 After Effects 式动态图形，工程还是能 diff 的 JSON

sources: https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft README 'Get started' (cargo run --release -p effectcraft, `-- --demo`), 'Animate' (panels, keyframes, expressions), 'Export' (Render Queue, File ▸ Export ▸ Lottie JSON…, lists anything Lottie cannot express, no FFmpeg)
ROADMAP.md M9/M12 (306 effects, 280 on the GPU) and CLAUDE.md (egui UI, everything is a command)
Cargo.toml workspace members (crates/render, crates/gpu, crates/export) and filmcraft-* git dependencies
